transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're at production lock for The Last Orchard, so let's get the standard roundtable going. I'd like to ask our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes before we approve the final presentation plan. The draft has us at the Calder Cinema on October 18th with a digital cinema package, two public screenings, audience photography, a standard courtesy credit, a 10-player ensemble, and a 3 to 4 PM rehearsal. Anyone have any updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag several critical changes from the revised license email I received this morning from the Orchard Estate. The license permits exactly one public screening — not two. It also requires 35mm projection, not a digital cinema package. It prohibits any audience or house recording, so the audience photography in the draft plan would violate the license. And it requires the specific credit line 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate,' not just a standard courtesy credit. I haven't uploaded the email to the shared production packet yet, but these are confirmed changes we need to address before approving the plan.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report confirmed changes on the music side. I received the signed musicians' agreement after the rehearsal plan was circulated. It requires a 14-player ensemble — not 10 — and the conductor has approved only a 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18th, not the 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM slot in the draft. I haven't yet added the agreement to the shared call sheet, but these are confirmed changes we need to account for before approving the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.recording_policy: No audience or house recording permitted
